headline: Switching is
intro: Want to move your prescriptions to us? You ask, we contact your pharmacy and take care of the rest.

points.title: Tell us you want to switch
points.body: Call 416-789-0100 or visit us at 3250 Dufferin St #6 in North York.
points.tip: No need to call your old pharmacy.

points.title: We contact your pharmacy
points.body: Ontario rules let the new pharmacy request the transfer, so we do the paperwork for you.
points.tip: Ask us which prescriptions can move.

points.title: Pick up or get delivery
points.body: Collect your medications in store, or ask about prescription delivery across Ontario.
points.tip: Ask about free blister packs too.

points.title: What our patients say
points.quote: The staff were incredibly helpful and understanding. They … offered to handle the transfer process entirely.

cta_body: Call 416-789-0100 and we'll take care of the transfer.
caption_instagram:
Switching pharmacies takes 3 easy steps 📋

Looking for a prescription transfer in Toronto? At our North York pharmacy near Yorkdale, you don't have to call your old pharmacy. Just tell us you want to switch, and we contact your current pharmacy and request the transfer for you. Have ready: your name and date of birth, your current pharmacy's name and phone number, and which prescriptions you'd like to move. Then pick up in store or ask about prescription delivery across Ontario.

💾 Save this for later and send it to someone who's been meaning to switch.

🔗 Link in bio: quiickmedicine.ca
📍 3250 Dufferin St #6, North York (near Yorkdale)
📞 416-789-0100

For general awareness only. Follow your healthcare professional's advice.
